newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African province grants gaming-related licences.
newsitem.headline: S.African province grants gaming-related licences.

text.p: South Africa's Mpumalanga province said on Monday it had granted gambling industry-related manufacturing, maintenance and supplier licences to four South African firms and one Japanese group.
The permits are the first to be granted since legislation liberalised South Africa's gaming laws, freeing up provinces to grant casino licences.
The firms are Japan's Sigma Inc, Atronic Casino Technology Africa Ltd, John Huxley SA Ltd, Africa Leisure Ltd and Monyaka Barcrest SA Ltd.

In January this year Mpumalanga announced preferred bidders for three casino operations and other provinces have followed suit. The central and highly industrialised province of Gauteng has invited bids for up to six licences.
